verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library designed to run anywhere Python runs—laptops, notebooks, Airflow, Dagster, Lambda, containers—and docs explicitly cover GitHub Actions CI deployment and a CLI for pipeline creation/inspection/deployment, all headless and scriptable. Community feedback corroborates it as a lightweight, code-first library well suited to automated pipelines rather than a UI-dependent tool. Missing for 10: independent hands-on CI benchmarking/case study beyond docs claims.
